subject: Civic Hall calendar and event-detail recovery for January 2016 NYC Council constituent-services hackathon
method: Wayback CDX enumeration and deduplicated HTML review across Civic Hall pages and event URL prefixes.
corpusSummary: Reviewed 4,630 deduplicated HTML captures representing 1,240 original URLs.
querySummary: A separate all-status event-prefix pass reviewed 296 event URL keys: 215 successful pages, 74 redirects, and seven 404 captures.
findings: Civic Hall's embedded social feed preserved a January 30, 1-3 p.m. NYC Council constituent-services hackathon announcement.
An event-day NYC Council post identified the gathering at Civic Hall as its first CouncilStat hackathon.
A promotional graphic used New York City Council Hackathon branding.
The RSVP resolved to a Civic Hall-domain Google Form that is now unavailable.
limitations: Failure to recover a listing is not proof that no listing ever existed.
Private temporary research artifacts remain outside the repository.
